_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment. See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-users-keycloak container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-users-keycloak container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-users-keycloak container in MiB

deployment.description: mod-users-keycloak keeps user migration job state in PostgreSQL and checks for an in-progress migration there before starting a new one, so replicas can run side by side behind a load balancer. Kafka consumers share a consumer group per module version, so system-user and user events are processed once across replicas. The Keycloak realm/client configuration and admin token Caffeine caches are local to each replica and are refreshed only on TTL expiry (KC_CONFIG_TTL, KC_ADMIN_TOKEN_TTL). Password reset tokens are stored as Keycloak user attributes, so they are shared across replicas. Two replicas are recommended for availability.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient; the user migration endpoints return as soon as the async job is scheduled rather than waiting for it to finish.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database host

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database username (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database password (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name holding the mod-users-keycloak schema (user migration jobs and the tenant module-version marker table)

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host. Used to consume system-user and user events and to publish event-confirmation results

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Security protocol used to communicate with Kafka brokers (PLAINTEXT or SSL)

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the Kafka client key store. Applies when KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL requires SSL client authentication

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the Kafka client key store

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_LOCATION
EnvVars.description: Filesystem path to the Kafka client trust store. Applies when KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL is SSL

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the Kafka client trust store

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SYS_USER_TOPIC_PATTERN
EnvVars.description: Topic name pattern for the system-user topic filled by mgr-tenant-entitlements

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_USER_TOPIC_PATTERN
EnvVars.description: Topic name pattern for the users topic filled by mod-users

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_USER_TOPIC_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumer threads for the users topic listener

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables marker-table-based Kafka tenant filtering for mixed-version deployments. Set to true when this deployment shares a Kafka cluster/topic with another module version

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SYS_USER_TOPIC_RETRY_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Delay between system-user event retry attempts when the tenant is not yet initialized

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SYS_USER_TOPIC_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Maximum retry attempts for a system-user event when the tenant is not yet initialized (default is effectively infinite)

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_USER_TOPIC_RETRY_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Delay between users event retry attempts on transient failures

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_USER_TOPIC_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Maximum retry attempts for a users event on transient failures (default is effectively infinite)

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SYS_USER_ROLE_RETRY_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Delay between attempts to upsert loadable roles and assign them to the module system user

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SYS_USER_ROLE_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of attempts to upsert loadable roles and assign them to the module system user

EnvVars.name: EVENT_CONFIRMATION_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables publishing of SUCCESS/FAILURE confirmations to mgr-tenant-entitlements after processing a system-user event

EnvVars.name: EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TOPIC
EnvVars.description: Kafka topic used to publish system-user event confirmation results. Applies when EVENT_CONFIRMATION_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_USERNAME_TEMPLATE
EnvVars.description: Template used to generate the system user username for each tenant

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_EMAIL_TEMPLATE
EnvVars.description: Template used to generate the system user email for each tenant

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_ROLE
EnvVars.description: Name of the role assigned to the system user on tenant initialization

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_PASSWORD_LENGTH
EnvVars.description: Length of the generated system user password

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_RETRY_COUNT
EnvVars.description: Number of attempts to create a system user

EnvVars.name: SYSTEM_USER_RETRY_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Delay in milliseconds between attempts to create a system user

EnvVars.name: MIGRATION_BATCH_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Batch size of users processed at a time by the user migration job. Max value is 50

EnvVars.name: IDP_MIGRATION_BATCH_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Batch size of users processed at a time by the identity provider (IDP) linking migration. Max value is 50

EnvVars.name: DEFAULT_PASSWORDS_ON_MIGRATION
EnvVars.description: When true, a migrated user's password is set to their username; otherwise migrated users get no credentials

EnvVars.name: INCLUDE_ONLY_VISIBLE_PERMISSIONS
EnvVars.description: When true, only visible permissions (UI permissions/permission-set names) are returned by the _self endpoint

EnvVars.name: SINGLE_TENANT_UX
EnvVars.description: Enables single tenant UX mode (federated authentication through a Keycloak identity provider)

EnvVars.name: IDENTITY_PROVIDER_SUFFIX
EnvVars.description: Suffix of the Keycloak OIDC identity provider that performs federated authentication requests. Applies when SINGLE_TENANT_UX is true

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical deployment name, used as the Kafka topic prefix and as the default first segment of the secure store key; must match the value used by the other modules

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL (the module's sidecar) used to perform HTTP requests to other FOLIO modules

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Deployed module version. Required for mixed-version deployments and must exactly match MODULE_VERSION of the associated sidecar

EnvVars.name: SERVER_PORT
EnvVars.description: HTTP port the module listens on

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the mod-users-keycloak process (heap sizing, GC, agent flags, etc.)

EnvVars.name: KC_URL
EnvVars.description: Keycloak base URL used to perform Keycloak Admin API requests

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Keycloak admin client ID used for issuing admin tokens. Its secret is read from the secure store, not from an environment variable

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_GRANT_TYPE
EnvVars.description: OAuth2 grant type used to obtain the Keycloak admin token

EnvVars.name: KC_PASSWORD_RESET_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Keycloak client ID used for password reset flows

EnvVars.name: KC_LOGIN_CLIENT_SUFFIX
EnvVars.description: Client name suffix appended to the tenant name when resolving the Keycloak login client that owns the authorization resources (used as audience when evaluating permissions); must match the login client naming used elsewhere in the deployment

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables TLS for the Keycloak Admin API client

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Truststore file path for the Keycloak Admin API client. Required when KC_CLIENT_TLS_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Truststore password for the Keycloak Admin API client

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_TLS_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore file type for the Keycloak Admin API client (e.g. JKS, PKCS12)

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_TOKEN_TTL
EnvVars.description: Time to live for the cached Keycloak admin token

EnvVars.name: KC_CONFIG_TTL
EnvVars.description: Time to live for the cached Keycloak realm configuration and client configuration

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Secure store backend holding client secrets (e.g. the Keycloak admin client secret) and system user passwords. Supported values: EPHEMERAL, AWS_SSM, VAULT, FSSP

EnvVars.name: SECURE_STORE_ENV
EnvVars.description: First segment of the secure store key, for example prod or test. Defaults to the value of ENV, with fallback to 'folio'

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_REGION
EnvVars.description: AWS region of the SSM client. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM; when unset the AWS default region provider chain is used

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM
EnvVars.description: Use the IAM role of the running task for SSM authorization instead of explicit credentials. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT
EnvVars.description: The HTTP endpoint used to retrieve AWS credentials. Ignored when SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM is true

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path component of the credentials endpoint URI, appended to SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TOKEN
EnvVars.description: Token for accessing Vault, may be a root token. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: Address of the Vault instance. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ENABLE_SSL
EnvVars.description: Whether to use SSL when connecting to Vault

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_PEM_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to an X.509 certificate in unencrypted PEM format (UTF-8), used for Vault SSL verification

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password used to access the Vault client JKS keystore

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to a JKS keystore file containing a Vault client cert and private key

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to a JKS truststore file containing trusted Vault server certs

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: Base URL of the Folio Secure Store Proxy (FSSP). Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=FSSP

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_SECRET_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path within FSSP where module secrets are stored/retrieved

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_ENABLE_SSL
EnvVars.description: Whether to use SSL when connecting to FSSP

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to the truststore file used for the FSSP SSL connection

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Truststore file type for the FSSP client (e.g. JKS, PKCS12)

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the FSSP truststore file
